subject: Proposed MAP: Milestones, Owners & Target Close — please confirm
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP: Milestones, Owners & Target Close — please confirm

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today — appreciate the clarity on your performance and compliance priorities. Per our discussion, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft with two timeline options and proposed owners so we can align on scope, dependencies, and a target close date.

Attachments: [RDW_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)], [acme_requirements_summary.pdf (pdf, 180KB)]

Quick recap / highlights:
- Pilot scope: 2 product flows (Search suggestion + Support triage) — initial sample size: 50k requests/day
- Success criteria: <200ms 95th p99 token latency for critical flows; end-user quality threshold TBD
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence + audit logs required; security questionnaire kickoff is requested by your InfoSec team

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Confirm stakeholders & procurement/legal contacts — (owner: Acme) — due: Oct 12
2) Pilot configuration & test data handoff — (owner: Redwood) — due: Oct 20 (aggressive) / Oct 30 (conservative)
3) Security review & SOC2 evidence exchange — (owners: joint) — depends on InfoSec availability; estimate +2 weeks if third-party review required
4) Pilot run & evaluation (2 weeks) — (owner: Acme) — complete by Nov 6 (aggressive) / Nov 20 (conservative)
5) Contract & PO issuance — (owner: Acme Procurement) — target close: Nov 15 (conservative) / Oct 29 (aggressive)

Timeline options (pick one):
- Aggressive: 6 weeks to PO (target close end of Oct)
- Conservative: 10 weeks to PO (target close mid-Nov)

Asks from our side: please confirm by EOD Monday (Oct 12):
- Which timeline you prefer (aggressive vs conservative)
- Primary technical owner for the pilot and procurement/legal contact
- Any gating dependencies we missed (e.g., additional security vendors, procurement process steps)

Proposed next step: 30-min MAP kickoff next week to lock owners & dates. I can run this and bring Marissa and Rishi for technical/runbook details. Please reply with a preferred time or confirm stakeholders inline.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
Note: This is an initial draft; I’ll version the MAP after we lock the timeline and responsibilities.

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: Milestones, Owners & Target Close — please confirm

Thanks, Sergio — good summary. A few notes from our side after syncing with the team this morning:

- Timeline: leaning conservative given Q4 procurement backlog. Target close we can commit to today is Nov 15.
- Stakeholders: I will be the product sponsor; Priya Shah will own procurement. Please add Jason Lee (jason.lee@acmecorp.com) as the legal lead — he owns vendor contracts.
- Security dependency: we use an external assessor (TrustAudit). If TrustAudit needs to run a focused review, add ~2 weeks. That likely pushes the pilot window later.

Action items from Acme:
- Priya to introduce procurement alias to Redwood (procurement@acmecorp.com)
- Jason to start preliminary redline review when you send the initial contract

We’ll plan to run a conservative timeline unless Redwood is able to absorb the security review time. Appreciate the clear owners — please update the MAP and resend.

Best,
Alex
Director, Product Operations | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: Milestones, Owners & Target Close — updated owners + pilot ask

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Alex — and thanks for introducing Jason in the reply thread. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect the conservative timeline and added the owners you mentioned. New file attached: RDW_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx.

Changes / clarifications we made in v2:
- Target close: Nov 15 (conservative) — aligned
- Owners: Alex (product sponsor), Priya (procurement), Jason (legal)
- Security: flagged TrustAudit as a gating dependency; estimated +2 weeks for third-party review
- Pilot ask: recommend a 2-week canary with 2 model variants (baseline + quantized) to validate latency/cost tradeoffs; propose canary start: Nov 1 if security sign-off completed by Oct 28

Immediate asks:
1) Priya: can you confirm procurement alias for contract & PO communications (please reply with address)
2) Jason: would you like a tracked copy of our standard MSA to start a redline? I can send v1 to your inbox by EOD today
3) Alex: if Nov 15 is confirmed as the target close, we’ll schedule internal capacity and lock pricing & burst policy by Oct 20

If everyone is aligned, I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Tue 10/12 or Wed 10/13 — please indicate preferred day/time and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: [RDW_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 26KB)]

Thanks,
Sergio
